question: In 2016, 17.4 million voted Leave in Britain's EU referendum, out of 46.5 million registered. What percent of the electorate was that?
answer: 37.4% of the electorate, and 51.9% of the votes cast: one result, measured against two different wholes.
move: Name the whole before quoting a share: votes cast, or everyone eligible.
ask: Which share have I quoted without saying what it was a share of?
trap: 52%, the share of votes cast, not of the electorate.
hint: Divide the Leave votes by everyone registered, voters or not.
steps: Remain had 34.7%; the 27.8% who did not vote make up the rest.
37.4% of the electorate, and 51.9% of the votes cast: one result, measured against two different wholes.
source: Electoral Commission, EU referendum results and turnout, 2016
reference: Electoral Commission, EU referendum results and turnout, 23 June 2016
